jobs.occupation: One or more PhD Stipends in Direct Air Capture Technologies
jobs.description:
The future of climate action extends beyond reducing emissions
Atmospheric CO2 concentrations continue to rise despite global efforts to reduce emissions. Achieving climate neutrality will therefore require not only deep emission reductions but also large-scale carbon removal solutions. Direct Air Capture (DAC) is one of the few technologies capable of permanently removing CO2 directly from the atmosphere, but significant scientific and engineering challenges remain before DAC can be deployed at gigaton scale. Future DAC systems must be energy-efficient, economically viable, and designed around a fundamental understanding of how materials, processes, and system integration interact.

At Aalborg University, we are seeking ambitious PhD candidates who want to help develop the next generation of DAC technologies through advanced process modelling, experimental studies, and techno-economic evaluations.

The stipend is open for appointment from 1 January 2027 or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

In the future, removing CO2 from the atmosphere will become an essential part of climate action.
Atmospheric CO2 is already changing the climate. Reducing emissions is essential, but it may not be enough. We must also learn how to remove carbon already present in the atmosphere. Future Direct Air Capture systems will not simply capture CO2:

They will integrate with renewable energy systems. They will operate flexibly and balance the energy systems. They will become scalable climate infrastructure.

What this PhD is really about
The stipends are designed to contribute to two ambitious research initiatives that aim to accelerate the development of Direct Air Capture technologies:

Development of process-aware methodologies for evaluating emerging DAC liquid and solid sorbents and technologies. Development of predictive frameworks linking sorbent properties to process-level DAC performance.

Together, these efforts seek to establish the scientific foundations required to move DAC development from empirical trial-and-error toward predictive, data-driven design and scale-up.

The research environment and culture you will step into
You will join CarbonLab at Aalborg University, a growing research environment dedicated to carbon capture, carbon removal, and climate-positive technologies. We are a group of approximately 20 people currently represented by 7 different nationalities. Our research combines laboratory experiments, process modelling, experimental validation, techno-economic and LCA assessments, and system integration to accelerate the deployment of DAC solutions at scale.

At CarbonLab, we are building more than technologies; we are building a research community. Our researchers share ideas openly, collaborate across disciplines, and celebrate each other's successes. PhD students are treated as colleagues, encouraged to develop their own scientific identity, and supported in taking initiative from the very beginning. Whether presenting at international conferences, contributing to teaching, leading collaborations, or exploring new research directions, you will be part of a culture that combines scientific ambition with mutual trust and genuine support. We believe that excellent research and an excellent research environment go hand in hand.

Your research qualifications
We are looking for highly motivated candidates who are passionate about addressing climate change through scientific research and technological innovation. The ideal candidate has a strong analytical mindset, enjoys solving complex engineering challenges, and is eager to contribute to the development of next-generation carbon removal technologies.

You should hold a master's degree (or be close to completion) in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Energy Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, or a related discipline.

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage:

Direct Air Capture, carbon capture, or carbon removal technologies Chemical process engineering and process intensification Mass transfer, reaction engineering, and thermodynamics Experimental design and laboratory testing Spectroscopy and related analytical techniques such as Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR). Measurement and interpretation of gas-liquid and gas-solid equilibrium data and breakthrough experiments. Process modelling and simulation (e.g., Aspen Plus, MATLAB, Python, or similar tools) Data analysis, optimization, and uncertainty assessment Techno-economic analysis and sustainability assessment Energy systems integration and renewable energy technologies

In addition, we value candidates who:

Demonstrate scientific curiosity and creativity Take initiative and ownership of their research Enjoy working both independently and collaboratively Communicate scientific results effectively in written and spoken English Thrive in an interdisciplinary and international research environment Are motivated to contribute to solutions with real-world climate impact

Previous research experience through master's projects, internships, conference contributions, or scientific publications is considered an advantage but is not a formal requirement.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    
AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real-world energy challenges. The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate. We offer access to advanced laboratories and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday life. New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
• Curriculum Vitae (CV)
• Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
• Project description (2-5 pages), that describes the applicant’s initial thoughts and ideas related to the specific project applied for. This includes a brief state-of-the-art (including short list of references), a time schedule and how the applicant intends to shed light on the project objectives.
• Other relevant documents
The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Do you have any questions?     
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employment
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Do you have a sharp eye for marine species and want to put your taxonomic skills to work in both research and national monitoring? The Department of Ecoscience at Aarhus University, Denmark, invites applications for a 2-year position as research assistant in marine taxonomy, focusing on phytoplankton, macroalgae and benthic fauna. The place of work is Aarhus, and the position starts on 1 January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Expected start date and duration of employment
This is a 2-year fixed-term position from 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Job description
Taxonomic expertise is the foundation of reliable knowledge about marine biodiversity, and of the monitoring that Danish authorities use to assess the state of the marine environment. You will help maintain and develop the department's taxonomic expertise and link it to new methods such as eDNA, ROV-based surveys and model-ling. Your tasks will include:

• Identification and quantification of phytoplankton, macroalgae and benthic fauna in samples from field surveys and monitoring programmes
• Data management, quality assurance and reporting as part of the department's advisory work for the Danish Environmental Protection Agency
• Contributing to research projects on marine biodiversity, e.g. in cultivated seaweed
You will work in close collaboration with experienced taxonomists and researchers at the Department of Ecoscience.

Your profile
Applicants should hold a Master's degree in biology, marine biology or a related field. We expect that you have:

• Documented experience in identifying marine organisms, preferably within phytoplankton, macroalgae and/or benthic fauna
• Experience with marine field work
• Experience with laboratory work and good laboratory practice
• Experience with data handling, quality assurance and reporting
• Good English skills, written and oral
• A structured and careful approach to your work and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team
It will be an advantage if you have:

• Experience with national monitoring programmes, e.g. NOVANA
• Experience with molecular methods such as eDNA, or with ROV or other image-based survey methods
• Skills in data analysis, e.g. in R
• An interest in research-based advice to authorities
Who we are
The Department of Ecoscience conducts national and international research and advisory projects covering all major subdisciplines within marine, freshwater and terrestrial ecology. The department is a recognised authority in research-based advice to Danish authorities and is responsible for large parts of the national monitoring of the marine environment. We are currently about 340 employees.

You will join the Section for Marine Ecology. Read more at AU Ecoscience - Research in marine ecology. For more information on the department, see https://ecos.au.dk/en/.

What we offer
The department offers:

• the opportunity to work with experienced taxonomists and to develop your skills within both classic and new methods
• a combination of field work, laboratory work, research and advice to authorities
• a well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment
• a work environment with close working relationships, networking and social activities
• a workplace characterised by professionalism, equality and a healthy work-life balance.
Place of work and area of employment
The place of work is Aarhus University, C.F. Møllers Allé 3, 8000 Aarhus C, Denmark, and the area of employ-ment is Aarhus University with related departments.

Contact information

For further information, please contact: Head of Section, Annette Bruhn, +45 2963 8034, anbe@ecos.au.dk.

Deadline
Applications must be received no later than Tuesday 1 December 2026. 

Application procedure
Short-listing is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the assessment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. The selection is made on the basis of an assessment of who of the candidates are most relevant considering the requirements of the advertisement. All applicants will be notified within 6 weeks whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee and will receive his/her assessment.

jobs.description:
Drive Market Readiness for the Next Generations of Hearing Solutions

At Demant Hearing Aids, we are transforming how we bring innovation to market through our new Product-to-Success (P2S) framework. As a global organization with a strong cadence of product launches, our competitiveness depends on turning innovation into meaningful value for our customers and users.

We are looking for a commercially minded and highly collaborative Project Director, Commercial Market Readiness. This is a new role in which you will bring the voice of the markets into global product development and launch planning. You will also ensure that global plans are translated into market-ready execution, so our innovations deliver successful commercial outcomes.

As a key member of the Program Management Team (PMT), you will lead Market Readiness deliveries across Marketing, Sales, Training, and Service. Your objective is to ensure that the commercial organization is fully prepared to launch new products successfully.

This role sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, program execution, and cross-functional leadership. You will connect activities across the Growth Engine (Global Marketing) and Revenue Engine (Global Sales), creating alignment and ensuring coordinated execution. We are recruiting two new Market Readiness colleagues for this role, who will alternate lead responsibility across releases, giving each release one clear Market Readiness lead (internally referred to as NMRI). The roles will report to the respective commercial leaders in Marketing and Sales.

Experience from a market organization, sales company, or another market-facing role will be a strong advantage, giving you valuable insight into customer needs, commercial execution, product adoption, and market impact.

Your Responsibilities

As our Commercial Market Readiness Lead, you will:

Lead Market Readiness in the Program Management Team

• Communicate global strategies and launch plans ensuring locally executable plans and launch readiness across markets.

• Champion market needs and launch realities within the program, ensuring decisions reflect the perspectives of customers and users, hearing care professionals and sales companies.

• Represent Market Readiness in the PMT and ensure timely, high-quality delivery against agreed milestones.

• Coordinate cross-functional activities and provide clear visibility of progress, risks, dependencies, quality, compliance, and overall readiness.

• Enable confident and timely decisions through concise status reporting, clear recommendations, and early escalation of critical issues.

Act as a Commercial and Strategic Leader

• Ensure market readiness activities align with broader business objectives and commercial ambitions.

• Drive collaboration across global and local functions, ensuring market perspectives influence key program decisions and that solutions are practical, scalable, and relevant for local execution.

• Translate market insights and commercial realities into actionable recommendations for the program and leadership teams.

What You Bring

We are looking for an experienced leader who combines strong commercial understanding and market understanding with excellent project and stakeholder management capabilities. As this is a new role, you will have a unique opportunity to shape and establish it together with colleagues across the global and local value chain.

Experience

• First-hand experience in a market-facing role or in close partnership with sales companies, with the ability to bring an outside-in perspective to program decisions.

• Significant experience in commercial project leadership, product launches, market readiness, or a related field.

• Proven ability to navigate complex stakeholder landscapes and influence without direct authority.

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in business or a related field, combined with at least five years of experience in sales, marketing, project management, or another commercial environment.

Competencies

• Lead with a strong business and commercial mindset.

• Create clarity, alignment, and momentum across diverse stakeholder groups.

• Drive predictability and transparency through disciplined planning and execution.

• Practice structured, timely, and effective communication.

• Build trust and collaboration across functions and organizational levels.

How to apply

If you thrive in a dynamic environment where commercial impact, stakeholder leadership, and program excellence come together, we would love to hear from you.

To apply, please submit your CV and a short motivation letter via our online application portal no later than November 22nd, 2026.

For further information about the position, please contact Dorthe Krogh Jensen, Vice President, Brand Management, at djen@demant.com or Steven Schmidt, Head of Global Sales at stns@demant.com

We expect to conduct first-round interviews during weeks 48-49, with second-round interviews taking place in week 50.

Join us and help turn innovation into market success.

At Demant, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnicity, age, gender, personality, disability, or educational background. Diversity is an integral part of our culture, and we particularly encourage women pursuing careers in STEM to apply, supporting United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5: Gender Equality.

About Demant

Demant is a world-leading hearing healthcare and technology group built on a heritage of care, health, and innovation since 1904. The Group offers innovative technologies, solutions, and expertise to help people hear better. In every aspect, from hearing care, hearing aids and hearing implants to diagnostic equipment and services and audio solutions, Demant is active and engaged. Headquartered in Denmark, the Group employs more than 21,000 people globally and is present with solutions in 130 countries where we create life-changing hearing health and high-end audio and video solutions. William Demant Foundation holds the majority of shares in Demant A/S, which is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and among the 25 most traded stocks.

Are you an experienced assistant who thrives in a dynamic international environment? Do you enjoy creating structures, enabling effective decision-making and helping leadership teams execute global priorities? And are you looking for a role where your ability to bring clarity, alignment and momentum will make a real difference? Then you might be our new HR Leadership Team Assistant in Demant Group Services.

Supporting leadership excellence across global HR

As HR Leadership Team Assistant, you will play a central role in supporting Demant's Global HR Leadership Team and the newly established HR Portfolio team. Acting as a trusted coordination partner to senior HR leaders, you will help create structure, transparency and momentum across leadership activities, strategic initiatives and transformation programmes.

In this role, you will ensure that leadership processes run smoothly and efficiently. You will coordinate activities across a broad stakeholder landscape, maintain visibility of priorities and actions, and help leaders stay focused on what matters most by providing high-quality operational and organisational support.

Meet your new team and manager

You will become part of the newly established HR Transformation Portfolio team within Demant HR and work closely with colleagues across Global HR. The team is focused on enabling strategic execution, strengthening collaboration and supporting key HR initiatives across the organisation.

The position reports to Nina Castler, Head of HR Transformation Portfolio Management, and works closely with members of the Global HR Leadership Team. The position is based at the Demant Headquarters in Smørum, Copenhagen. We offer flexibility to work from home when business needs and tasks allow.

Enabling leadership effectiveness and strategic execution

• Coordinate HR Leadership Team meetings, governance forums and strategic initiatives involving senior stakeholders across functions, countries and time zones

• Drive agenda planning by gathering input from stakeholders

• Capture decisions, actions and deadlines while maintaining visibility and follow-up to support execution across the team

• Support planning and stakeholder coordination related to key HR transformation and operating model initiatives

• Manage complex calendars, competing priorities and leadership activities in a fast-paced global environment

• Prepare presentations, reports, organisational information and leadership materials that support informed decision-making

• Identify opportunities to improve processes, strengthen ways of working and leverage Microsoft 365 and AI tools to increase efficiency and consistency

In addition, you will help create structure and governance which enable a growing global HR organisation to collaborate effectively and deliver on its strategic ambitions.

Your qualifications & experience

We imagine that you will bring a combination of:

• Solid experience from a Team Assistant, Executive Assistant, Project Assistant, Business Support or similar role within a complex international organization supporting leadership teams and cross-functional stakeholders

• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to navigate competing priorities across organisational levels

• Proven experience creating structure, driving coordination and ensuring follow-through in a fast-paced environment

• Experience preparing presentations, reports, meeting documentation and materials for leadership audiences

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365 tools and an interest in AI, automation and process optimisation

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken

Being highly organised, proactive and service-minded is a strong foundation for this role, and we are looking for someone who will naturally create structure in complex environments, anticipate challenges and stay one step ahead. At the same time, you are comfortable asking questions, challenging assumptions and contributing to discussions when needed. You thrive in an environment with multiple stakeholders, know how to prioritise when demands exceed capacity and build trusted relationships through professionalism, credibility and sound judgement.

Meet your new team

This is an opportunity to join a highly capable and collaborative HR leadership environment during a period of significant transformation. You will work closely with senior leaders, gain unique insight into global HR priorities and play an important role in shaping how HR operates and delivers value across the organisation.

You will become part of a team that values partnership, transparency and continuous improvement, where your contribution will be visible and where the structure you create will have a tangible impact across a global stakeholder network. For the right person, the role offers broad exposure, meaningful responsibility and opportunities to expand your scope over time.

Ready to join Demant's HR Portfolio team?

We will be reviewing applications on a rolling basis and aim to initiate the interview process at the end of November.

Are you excited by operating in the intersection of technology, commercial strategy, and business transformation? Do you thrive when translating complex business needs into practical system solutions that deliver measurable value across a global organisation? Then you may be our new Product owner, pricing solutions in Hearing Aids.

Take our pricing solutions to the next level

In this newly established role, you will play a key part in shaping how pricing is managed across our global business. You will join a major ERP transformation programme and take ownership of the pricing solution that connects commercial pricing strategies with operational execution. Working closely with pricing, commercial, finance, and IT stakeholders, you will help create scalable solutions that support business growth and enable better commercial decision-making.

Your impact as our new product owner, pricing solutions

As Product owner, pricing solutions, you will ensure that pricing strategies can be implemented, maintained, and continuously improved through our systems and processes. You will translate business requirements into technical solutions, drive implementation activities, and act as the key link between commercial stakeholders and IT teams.

You will play a central role in our global D365 Finance & Operations and QFO rollout programmes, helping to establish the pricing capabilities that will support our future commercial landscape. The team combines commercial expertise, pricing knowledge, and process excellence, and works closely with colleagues across markets, functions, and countries.

As part of a large-scale global transformation programme involving colleagues from around the world, you can expect international collaboration and approximately 30 to 40 travel days per year.

Drive pricing transformation in a global organisation

Your key responsibilities are:

• Own and drive the pricing solution across global ERP rollout programmes from requirements gathering through go-live and hypercare

• Translate commercial pricing strategies, pricing models, rebates, promotions, discounts, and agreements into scalable system solutions

• Manage and prioritise the pricing backlog, defining user stories, acceptance criteria, and business requirements

• Drive continuous improvement of pricing processes, data structures, and governance to support long-term business success

You combine commercial understanding with technical curiosity

Success in this role requires more than pricing knowledge or system expertise alone. You enjoy working across disciplines and can comfortably move between commercial discussions, technical specifications, business processes, and stakeholder management. You are naturally curious, organised, and able to bring clarity to complex challenges.

We imagine that you have:

• 5+ years of experience within product ownership, business analysis, pricing, ERP, commercial systems, or related areas

• Experience translating business requirements into system capabilities and working closely with IT or development teams

• Understanding of pricing processes, commercial operations, revenue management, or Order-to-Cash processes

• Experience with ERP platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, Oracle, or similar enterprise solutions

• Familiarity with agile methodologies, backlog management, sprint planning, or SAFe-based ways of working

• Strong analytical capabilities and an interest in data-driven decision-making and process optimisation

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills in a global environment

You know how to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, and create practical solutions that balance business needs with technical possibilities. Equally important, you build strong relationships and work effectively with stakeholders at all levels of an international organisation.

Want to join the team?

Turn commercial priorities into practical sales capabilities that make a measurable difference

Do you get energy from helping sales professionals build confidence, sharpen their skills and succeed with customers? Would you like to develop learning solutions that can be used across markets in a global organisation? Then this may be the opportunity for you.

The team is a smaller international team with five colleagues having focus on sales training, sales product training and sales enablement. We work closely together in a collaborative, hands-on way, always keeping our target audience at the center of everything we do.

• Practical experience designing, developing or delivering training for sales professionals.

• Strong project-management skills and the ability to move several activities forward with clear priorities and follow-up.

• The ability to communicate complex concepts clearly and make learning relevant in day-to-day sales situations.

• Experience with blended learning, digital learning design, authoring tools, LMSs or LXPs.

How you work:
